ai-mathematics.title: AI & Mathematics
ai-mathematics.label: Section One
ai-mathematics.description: The vocabulary of machine learning, statistics, optimisation and the linear algebra underneath all of it. Every entry is defined in terms a reader can substitute back into a sentence, then anchored to the paper or theorem it came from.

software-engineering.title: Software Engineering Core
software-engineering.label: Section Two
software-engineering.description: The working vocabulary of building and running software — algorithms, architecture, concurrency, databases, security and the field's durable jargon. Definitions are written to be substitutable, and the idioms carry the origin story only where it is actually documented.
